description: Boulder County Public Works publishes point locations and attributes for major and minor structures on county-owned roads. The schema includes structure identifiers, crossed features, type, material, span, width, height, construction year, ownership, maintenance and asset status. Dimension aliases specify inches. Active-from and active-to dates are present. The provider states that replaced structures remain in the inventory, so historical records require separation from current assets. The locations and structural attributes can supply asset descriptions for road-network resilience studies. They do not establish structural capacity, condition ratings or failure probabilities. This dataset is maintained by Public Works; the metadata does not establish the physical inspection date of each structure. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
